integrity: Proof is symbolic and self-contained apart from classical digit-sum factorial valuations. Finite exact-integer histogram verifier is supplied for corroboration; literature equivalence is not ruled out by search alone.
scientific_limitations: Results require p prime, m positive and coprime to p, r>=1; total-variation convergence fixes p,m. No claims for p|m, higher-power residues, or independent external validation. The underlying Kummer and Legendre valuation formulas are classical.
title: Exact valuation polynomials and a geometric limit for dilated Narayana rows
